app.name: KS Vault
lock.patternPad: Pattern pad: draw a pattern through the dots
lock.mismatch: They did not match. Start again.
setup.title: Set up KS Vault
setup.intro: Choose a password or a pattern. There is no way to recover it: if you forget it, everything in the vault is lost.
unlock.title: KS Vault is locked

unlock.wrong.one: Wrong. One more try before a wait.
unlock.wrong.other: Wrong. {count} more tries before a wait.

unlock.wrongLast: Wrong. The next wrong try means a longer wait.
unlock.wait: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {time}.
unlock.unreadable: The vault cannot be opened on this phone any more. Its key in the phone's secure storage is gone.
bio.settingHint: The password or pattern is still needed after the phone restarts, and after too many failed tries.
bio.notReady: Set up a fingerprint or face in the phone's settings first.
bio.enableTitle: Turn on fingerprint or face unlock
bio.enableIntro: Enter your password or pattern, then touch the sensor or look at the phone once.
bio.enablePrompt: Confirm with your fingerprint or face
erase.title: Erase the whole vault?
erase.message: Without the password or pattern nothing in the vault can be opened. Erasing deletes every note, ID card, ticket and file, so you can start again. This cannot be undone.
list.empty: Nothing here yet. Tap Add to save a note, an ID card or a ticket.
list.chooseItem: Choose a note, ID card or ticket to see it here.
field.title: Title
edit.title: Edit {kind}
edit.attachLater: After saving, you can add photos and PDF files.
copy.done: Copied. It is cleared from the clipboard in a minute.
attach.title: Photos and files
attach.hint: Copied into the vault and encrypted. The original stays where it was; delete it there if you want.
attach.tooLarge: That file is too big. The limit is {mb} MB.
attach.unsupported: Only photos and PDF files can be added. Password-protected PDFs cannot be read.
attach.failed: The file could not be read.
camera.title: Take a photo
camera.asking: KS Vault needs the camera to take a photo. The photo goes straight into the vault, encrypted.
camera.denied: The camera is not allowed. You can allow it in the phone's settings for KS Vault, or add a photo from the gallery instead.
camera.failed: The photo could not be taken. Try again.
share.title: Save to KS Vault

share.files.one: {count} file to save in the vault.
share.files.other: {count} files to save in the vault.

share.failed.one: {count} file could not be added (only photos and PDFs up to 20 MB).
share.failed.other: {count} files could not be added (only photos and PDFs up to 20 MB).

share.outConfirmText: The text of this item leaves the vault and is no longer encrypted in the app you choose.
share.outConfirmFile: This file leaves the vault and is no longer encrypted in the app you choose. The vault stays open for up to 3 minutes while that app reads it.
reminder.setting: Remind me before an ID card expires
reminder.settingHint: 30 days and 7 days before, at 9:00. The notification does not say which card; unlock the vault to see.
reminder.title: An ID card expires soon
reminder.text: Unlock KS Vault to see which one.
settings.lockPassword: The vault is locked with a password.
settings.lockPattern: The vault is locked with a pattern.
settings.autoLockHint: The vault also locks as soon as you leave the app.
settings.updateOffline: KS Vault never goes online, so it does not check for updates. The button opens the download page in your browser.
settings.updatePlay: Updates come through Google Play. KS Vault itself never goes online.
settings.backupHint: Nothing leaves the phone by itself. A backup is a file you save where you choose, locked with its own password, so you can restore it on a new phone.
backup.title: Back up to a file
backup.intro: Choose a backup password. It locks the file and is needed to restore it. It is not your vault's password or pattern, and it cannot be recovered.
backup.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

backup.done.one: Saved {count} item to the backup file. Keep the backup password safe.
backup.done.other: Saved {count} items to the backup file. Keep the backup password safe.

backup.failed: The backup could not be saved.
restore.title: Restore from a file
restore.intro: Choose a KS Vault backup file and type its backup password.
restore.replaceMessage: Every note, ID card, ticket and file now in the vault is deleted and replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.
restore.wrongPassword: That backup password is not right. Nothing was changed.
restore.damaged: This is not a KS Vault backup, or the file is damaged. Nothing was changed.
restore.failed: The backup could not be read. Nothing was changed.
settings.aboutText: Everything is encrypted on this phone and nothing is ever sent anywhere: the app has no internet access and is left out of cloud backups. It cannot protect against a phone that is rooted or infected, someone who watches you unlock it, or someone who knows your password or pattern.
change.current: Enter your current password or pattern
change.wrong: That is not it. Try again.
